item.title: Venezuela inflation hit 475% in 2025, the world's highest level
item.description: Venezuelan inflation soared to 475 percent in 2025, the highest in the world, driven by a tightening of US sanctions in the lead up to the ouster of leader Nicolas Maduro.Full-year inflation far exceeded the International Monetary Fund's forecast of 269.9 percent, figures released by the central bank showed Friday.Accumulated inflation for the first two months of 2026 stood at nearly 52 percent, the bank, which had not released inflation figures in over a year, said.It did not issue a forecast f

item.title: Only Iran's 'unconditional surrender' can end war: Trump

item.title: Father, daughter among 4 killed in Dhaka road accidents
item.description: Four people were killed, including a man and his daughter, in separate road accident in the capital on Friday night.The deceased were identified as Saju Ahmed Sumon, 41, and his daughter Sumaiya Ahmed Trisha, 19, residents of Shahjahanpur area; CNG-run autorickshaw driver Md Alim and Md Harunur Rahman, 32.Saju Ahmed and his daughter Sumaiya were killed when a truck hit their motorbike in Science Lab area of the capital at about 11PM on Friday. Saju died on the spot and Sumaiya critically injured

item.title: 1,332 Iranian civilians killed in war: UN envoy
item.description: Iran's UN Ambassador Amir Saeid Iravani said on Friday that at least 1,332 Iranian civilians have died so far in the conflict with Israel and the US, and that thousands more have been injured.Speaking to reporters at the United Nations in New York, Iravani asserted that the US and Israel had deliberately targeted civilian infrastructure, while Iran had targeted military sites, not civilians.The US and Israel have said the opposite is the case.Iravani said Iran was also not targeting the interest

item.title: US Treasury Secy forecasts ‘biggest bombing campaign’ yet on Iran
item.description: United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been speaking to Fox News and said “tonight will be our biggest bombing campaign” against Iran.He said the US attack will “do the most damage to the Iranian missile launchers, the factories that build the missiles, and we are substantially degrading them”.Bessent has also accused Iran of “trying to create economic chaos”, pointing to Tehran’s control of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: 3 houses gutted in Patuakhali fire
item.description: At least three houses belonging to very poor family have been gutted in a devastating fire in Patuakhali's Bauphal upazila.The fire broke out at around 11PM on Friday (March 6) in the house of Mridha in Kayna village of Sadar Union of the Upazila. This has caused extensive damage.The families of farmer Ruhul, his cousin Farhad and the family of day laborer Motaleb have lost everything and are destitute in the fire.However, the exact extent of the damage has not yet been determined.Sabbir Hossain

item.title: Ferry services on Daulatdia–Paturia route resume
item.description: Ferry services on the Daulatdia–Paturia river route resumed on Saturday morning after being suspended for nearly two hours due to dense fog.According to authorities, ferry services returned to normal at around 9:10 AM on Saturday.Earlier, services had been halted from approximately 7:30 AM after sudden heavy fog reduced visibility on the river route.To avoid potential accidents caused by poor visibility, several ferries were anchored at terminals on both sides of the route.
